name: Tigerpass
description: Hardware-secured crypto wallet and trading terminal for AI agents. Trade Hyperliquid perpetual futures and spot, bet on Polymarket prediction markets, swap tokens across 6 EVM chains via 0x aggregator, bridge USDC cross-chain with Circle CCTP V2, execute any smart contract, sign EIP-191/EIP-712 messages, handle x402 HTTP payments, and sell services to other agents via ACE Protocol with E2E encrypted messaging. Private keys live in Apple Secure Enclave — physically impossible to extract. The only agent wallet combining hardware security with full autonomous signing. Requires Apple Silicon Mac.
longDescription:
Ships **1 skill**, `tigerpass` (Crypto wallet and trading terminal for AI agents — trade Hyperliquid perps and spot, bet on Polymarket predictions,…).

Installs with `claude plugin install tigerpass@claude-community` from `TigerPassNet/tigerpass-skill`.
